w4s-wake-window.note: Concrete newborn fact (feeding counts as awake time) but not a myth-buster; 12-18 month row has no published range, so it says '3 jam lebih' and the slide labels every number 'kisaran kasar'.

w4s-jam-tidur.note: Jam 8 corrects late bedtimes with a number, but parents of 10 pm sleepers may feel judged (CTA softens it); bedtimes are our arithmetic from SCHN/AASM, and the baby row gives no clock time.

w4s-growth-spurt.note: Hits the commonest ASI-kurang worry head on; the hook is absolute on its own, so the sub line and wet-diaper note carry the safety limit.
